key_insight: The paper lays out a roadmap to achieve practical quantum advantage with neutral atoms by co-developing hardware scaling, error correction, compilation, and distributed architectures.
engineering_relevance: It identifies the main system-level engineering priorities needed to turn neutral-atom processors into useful quantum computers, from faster readout and continuous reloading to integrated photonic control.
method: Define practical quantum advantage and how to verify it.
Improve neutral-atom hardware: larger arrays, better qubit encodings, below-threshold logical performance, fast readout, and reloading.
Advance software/system layers: quantum error correction, circuit compilation, and multi-processor networking.
evidence_signal: The abstract is a strategic review and roadmap paper, so its support comes from proposed evaluation criteria and design directions rather than new experimental datasets.
watch_item: Major risks remain in achieving reliable below-threshold performance and scalable control integration across large, networked neutral-atom systems.
paper_title: Strategic Plan for Neutral Atom Quantum Computation
